en.headline: Indonesian domestic helper charged with murder of 93-year-old employer
en.dek: The 52-year-old was remanded after being charged at Kwun Tong Court, following the death of the elderly woman at Tak Long Estate last Sunday.
body: An Indonesian domestic helper has been charged with the murder of her 93-year-old employer and remanded in custody.

Kharsina, 52, appeared at Kwun Tong Court on Wednesday to face the charge. Police had arrested her in the early hours of Monday after the elderly woman was found unresponsive in her flat at Long Yiu House, Tak Long Estate in Kai Tak, on Sunday morning.

Paramedics treated the woman at the scene and took her to hospital, where she was pronounced dead. The case is being investigated as murder, and the helper remains in custody pending further proceedings.

zh.headline: 印尼外傭被控謀殺93歲僱主 還押候訊
zh.dek: 52歲女外傭周三在觀塘裁判法院被控謀殺，上日在啟德德朗邨單位被發現昏迷的93歲女僱主已證實不治。
body: 一名印尼外傭被控謀殺其93歲僱主，並還押候訊。
52歲的Kharsina周三在觀塘裁判法院提堂。警方周一凌晨拘捕她，事緣周日早上在啟德德朗邨龍耀樓單位內，女僱主被發現昏迷不醒。
救護員在場施救後將她送院，其後證實不治。案件列作謀殺，外傭仍被扣押，等候進一步法律程序。
